observations: All seven labels and both axis labels are legible and not clipped.
All four target points and the separate mean diamond fit within each method row.
Four colors plus distinct circle/square/up-triangle/down-triangle shapes distinguish targets.
Mean numbers are in dedicated right columns and do not cover target observations.
Legend is above both panels; footnotes remain within canvas.
Axis ranges start at 60 percent and 8 cm and are explicitly labelled enlarged. No bars originate from truncated axes.
All four fixed targets are shown for all seven methods, without intervals or selective winners.

skill_design.paradigm: Two aligned categorical point panels with complete repeated observations and equal-frame summary
skill_design.why: Expose all four observed target scores alongside the seven-method comparison; target-dependent reversals are scientifically material.
skill_design.alternatives: Mean-only bars would hide target heterogeneity. Error bars would imply unsupported replication uncertainty. Time-series lines would distract from the method comparison.
panels: right: common MAE cm, lower better
skill_design.palette: Okabe-Ito subset: blue, vermilion, green, reddish purple; black summaries
skill_design.caption: Starts with the descriptive mean result and explains complete target display, means, missing-prediction denominator, common support and previously seen single-sequence scope.
